data.title: Bitcoin Investors Who Bought Last Year's Rally Are Selling As Price Nears Their Break-Even, Glassnode Says
data.description: Analyst Ted Pillows said Bitcoin needed a weekly close above $87,500 for a strong rally, and risks a drop below $80,000 without one.
